class.name: TweensGdRunner
class.brief_description: Automatic playback runtime for one scene tree.
class.description: Prefer [code]Tweens.play[/code], [code]Tweens.play_all[/code], and [code]Tweens.cancel_tweens[/code]. The runner is created automatically and disposed when its scene tree exits. No autoload is needed. Node targets must be in the tree and own their playback; other Objects require an in-tree Node or SceneTree owner. C# equivalent: [code]TweenRuntime[/code] and node extension methods.

method.name: acquire
method.description: Returns or creates the automatic runtime for a live [param tree]. Use Godot's main thread.

method.name: cancel_tweens
method.description: Cancels active tweens owned by [param owner], optionally including descendant owners.

method.name: find
method.description: Returns the existing runtime for [param tree], or null. Does not create one.

method.name: play
method.description: Starts one definition and returns its playback handle. Node targets own their playback; other Objects require an in-tree Node or SceneTree owner. A rejected start returns a failed handle. Prefer [code]Tweens.play[/code].

method.name: play_all
method.description: Starts an Array of definitions in parallel and returns a group. Ownership follows [method play]. A rejected start cancels earlier members and prevents later starts. Prefer [code]Tweens.play_all[/code].

members.member: The scheduler driven by this runtime. Prefer [code]Tweens.play[/code] for automatic animation.
